segments.sensitive: The reviewers with sensitive skin who mention it report no irritation, describing the mask as soft and comfortable on their skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s to 80s report smoother, more hydrated, glowing skin after use, with some noting a visible softening of fine lines and wrinkles over repeated applications.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers, including ones in their late 30s to 80s, report a visible softening or disappearance of fine lines, forehead lines, and enlarged pores after use; one reviewer, however, used it consistently and reported no improvement in her forehead lines.
concerns.dehydration: Nearly every reviewer who addresses this reports noticeably softer, plumper, more hydrated skin after wearing the mask, sometimes lasting into the next day, with no reviewer reporting the mask left their skin drier.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports her skin looked less pink after use; the reviews otherwise say little about redness specifically.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers, including one with sensitive skin, report no burning, stinging, or irritation even after accidentally leaving the mask on for several hours; one reviewer, however, felt the serum itch her skin briefly at the start of application.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her uneven, blotchy skin tone cleared up after use; another says continued use could help with dark spots and pore size but had not yet confirmed this after a single application.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports her face looked oily and puffy after using two masks in four days and did not find it worth the money.

extraits.texte: Prior to using these face masks, I was not familiar with PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide), which are DNA fragments derived from the sperm cells of certain fish, like salmon. I read up on the concept of using PDRN, and found that there is ample research to support using it to stimulate collagen production, improve skin texture, and reduce fine lines and wrinkles, depending on the strength of PDRN used. After washing my face and applying toner, I put on the rather slippery, two-piece PDRN collagen mask. The texture of the mask is like thin silicone. The instructions state that the mask should be left on for one and a half to two hours. So this was definitely meant for use in the evening for me. As I was lying down while wearing the mask, it did not slide off my face. I found that I had to tug it a little to adequately cover the sides of my face, my forehead, and under my chin. After removing it two hours later, I massaged the remaining serum into my skin. I can say that the mask was not irritating to my skin; no burning, redness, or itching. My skin definitely felt smoother, but I suspect that the true impact of the PDRN will require additional mask treatments, because I did not see any improvement in the fine lines on my forehead. Nor did I notice a 'glow'. As it was, since I applied it right before bedtime, a glow would not have mattered. And if I had applied it for two hours early in the morning before work (and who has time for that), a glow would not have been apparent under

Not impressed. I used two within four days and the only thing I noticed was that my faced looked oily and puffy. Unless you are skinny and don’t have a lot of deep lines in your face it isn’t worth the money.

extraits.titre: Its going to take weeks on aged skin.  Patience.Its going to take weeks on aged skin.  Patience.
extraits.texte: Have used two of the four masks. First time the product took close to four hours to completely absorb. It felt nice, but little changed in appearance. Second time (4 days later) the absorbing timeframe was shorter but I chose to sleep in it. The appearance the next morning was noticeably improved. I intend to use this for six weeks before deciding if I will continue to invest. But after 1 week and two applications, I can say my skin feels better and looks nicer. Hoping in six week to have lost the lines that plague my mouth area, and chin. Im 69 and never did a regular skin routine, so considering that, Im impressed by the product.

extraits.titre: Little pricey - leaves face soft and brighter
extraits.texte: These masks are good quality, very hydrating, and soothing. There was a little smell to it that could bother some. They do slip a bit at first, so I had to sit back and relax for about 15–30 minutes before they fully adhered to my face. Once set, they stayed in place, and I could move around the house easily. I have sensitive skin and had no irritation at all. The masks were effective in leaving my face very soft and brighter. They are a little pricey, but you get 4 masks in the pack, which makes it feel like a nice self-care splurge.

Ummm this mask is phenomenal. I’ve tried several masks in the past and honestly they were nothing short of pure trash but this one is amazing. Forehead lines-gone. Frown lines-gone uneven blotchy skin tone- gone, huge pores- slammed shut, dry dull grey complection- gone. I’m only in my late 30’s and I work like a common animal 12+ hours a day 7 days a week so sometimes I look like I’m 50 no joke..This mask literally took 20 years off my face in the amount of time it took to take a nap. My skin is hydrated, glassy, smooth and looks healthy, no residue left behind and no greasy look or feel completely worth every cent. The only negative thing I could possibly say is putting it on at first Is slimy and cold and slides around on your face a bit but what do you expect. It’s wet And full of moisture. It’s not going to just cling to your face so put it on and lay down. Eventually you will feel it adhere to your face. Then you can go about your biz and forget it’s even on. This is the second time I’ve used one. The first one I had to take off after about an hour Abd a half but still saw some results. The second one I let stay on til it turned clear (about 2.5 hours) and it does what it says. So being consistent is key. I’m also a male so if anyone is wondering if it works on guys. It does. Wash your face well and dry it well. Put the mask on, lay down for a bit and let it do its thing. It’s a simple application process if you do it correctly. Will be buying more for sure

extraits.titre: All It’s Cracked Up To Be!
extraits.texte: You can believe all the hype about this product because it really works! My skin has never been so soft or looked so glowing since I’ve been using this mask once a week. I use a little Witch Hazel as a toner before applying the mask and I’ve had great results. It stays put and doesn’t move around. I keep it on overnight and wake up to refreshed, glowing skin. I’m 82 years old and don’t have many wrinkles, (thanks to my mom’s genes), but after using this, the few that I do have are disappearing! This stuff is great!!

It took me more than 2 1/2 hours for the mask to get clear. I love the shine on my skin; I wash my face, put some serum and place the mask. I place that little piece the I think it’s for the eyes in my lips, to see how it works, and it was fine. I like it, even though the serum itch my skin at the beginning, and it’s from the same brand.
